blockingFindings.summary: The reusable adapter implements only greenfield draft normalization.
evidence: MODULE is hard-coded to operation gather instead of supporting the module's establish-baseline and revise-baseline operation semantics.
proposalResult always constructs RequirementsDraft and ProjectOverviewDraft even when requirements-baseline and project-overview-baseline are exact invocation inputs.
No candidate code constructs or validates RequirementsChangeSet or ProjectOverviewChangeSetDraft, binds exact prior digests, or computes exhaustive changed sections.
The released runtime rejects a full-draft outcome for a baseline-bound invocation, so the adapter cannot complete the actual revise-baseline circuit.
